KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DEPLOYABLEBARRICADE: A deployable cover that can block incoming damage until it breaks.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_ZIPLINE: A deployable zipline that allows you to quickly move between two locations.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_REMOTEFLARETRAP: A deployable device that, when manually triggered, launches a Raider Distress Flare.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_EXPLOSIVEJUMPMINE: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and explodes, dealing damage to anything within its radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_JOLTMINE: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and stuns anything within its radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DOORBLOCKER: A locking mechanism that can be placed on large metal doors to limit access.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LASERTRAP_DOTGRENADE: A laser trip wire that detonates a Blaze Grenade.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LASERTRAP_SMOKEGRENADE: A laser trip wire that detonates a Smoke Grenade.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LASERTRAP_STAMINADOT: A laser trip wire that detonates a Gas Grenade.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_LASERTRAP_THROWABLEDECOY: A laser trip wire that detonates a Lure Grenade.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_TIMEDMINE_EXPLOSIVE: A mine that deals damage to anything within its radius once the timer runs out.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_JUMPMINE_STAMINADOT: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and deploys a gas cloud that rapidly drains stamina.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_JUMPMINE_IMPULSE: A proximity-triggered mine that pops up and knocks back anything within its radius.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DEPLOYABLESOUNDTRAP: A deployable proximity sensor that sounds an alarm when enemy Raiders are detected.
KeysToEntries.ST_ITEMDESC_LAUNCHPAD: A deployable pad that propels any Raider who steps on it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_REMOTETRAP_FIREWORKBOX: A remotely triggered arrangement of dazzling fireworks, sure to put on a show.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_EMITTERTRAP_TESLACOIL: A deployable device that periodically electrifies the area around itself and briefly stuns anything caught within it.
KeysToEntries.ID_ITEMDESC_DEPLOYABLERAIDERONASTICK: A deployable Raider helmet on a stick. Surprisingly convincing from afar.
